import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = (int)1e9;
    static final int T = 150;

    static class MinCostMaxFlow {
        int nodes;
        int[] dist, potential, prev_node_idx, prev_edge_idx;
        int flow_curr[];
        PriorityQueue<Pair> pq;
        List<List<Edge>> adj;

        class Edge {
            int to, rev;
            int flow, cap;
            int cost;

            Edge(int to, int rev, int flow, int cap, int cost) {
                this.to = to;
                this.rev = rev;
                this.flow = flow;
                this.cap = cap;
                this.cost = cost;
            }
        }

        class Pair implements Comparable<Pair> {
            int dist;
            int node;

            Pair(int dist, int node) {
                this.dist = dist;
                this.node = node;
            }

            public int compareTo(Pair other) {
                return Integer.compare(this.dist, other.dist);
            }
        }

        MinCostMaxFlow(int n) {
            this.nodes = n;
            dist = new int[n];
            potential = new int[n];
            prev_node_idx = new int[n];
            prev_edge_idx = new int[n];
            flow_curr = new int[n];
            pq = new PriorityQueue<>();
            adj = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
        }

        void add_edge(int s, int t, int cap, int cst) {
            adj.get(s).add(new Edge(t, adj.get(t).size(), 0, cap, cst));
            adj.get(t).add(new Edge(s, adj.get(s).size() - 1, 0, 0, -cst));
        }

        Pair max_flow_min_cost(int s, int t) {
            int total_flow = 0;
            int total_cost = 0;
            while (true) {
                pq.clear();
                Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
                dist[s] = 0;
                flow_curr[s] = INF;
                pq.add(new Pair(0, s));
                while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                    Pair p = pq.poll();
                    int d = p.dist;
                    int u = p.node;
                    if (d != dist[u]) continue;
                    for (int i = 0; i < adj.get(u).size(); i++) {
                        Edge e = adj.get(u).get(i);
                        int v = e.to;
                        if (e.cap <= e.flow) continue;
                        int new_dist = dist[u] + e.cost + potential[u] - potential[v];
                        if (dist[v] > new_dist) {
                            dist[v] = new_dist;
                            pq.add(new Pair(new_dist, v));
                            prev_node_idx[v] = u;
                            prev_edge_idx[v] = i;
                            flow_curr[v] = Math.min(flow_curr[u], e.cap - e.flow);
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (dist[t] == INF) break;
                for (int i = 0; i < nodes; i++) {
                    potential[i] += dist[i];
                }
                int delta = Math.min(flow_curr[t], INF - total_flow);
                total_flow += delta;
                for (int v = t; v != s; v = prev_node_idx[v]) {
                    Edge e = adj.get(prev_node_idx[v]).get(prev_edge_idx[v]);
                    e.flow += delta;
                    adj.get(v).get(e.rev).flow -= delta;
                    total_cost += delta * e.cost;
                }
            }
            return new Pair(total_flow, total_cost);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();

        int N = n * T;
        MinCostMaxFlow mcmf = new MinCostMaxFlow(N + 2);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < T - 1; j++) {
                mcmf.add_edge(i * T + j, i * T + j + 1, INF, c);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < T; i++) {
            mcmf.add_edge(i, N + 1, INF, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            mcmf.add_edge(N, x * T, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int y = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < T - 1; j++) {
                int cur = 1;
                for (int _ = 0; _ < k; _++) {
                    mcmf.add_edge(x * T + j, y * T + j + 1, 1, cur * d + c);
                    mcmf.add_edge(y * T + j, x * T + j + 1, 1, cur * d + c);
                    cur += 2;
                }
            }
        }

        Pair flow_result = mcmf.max_flow_min_cost(N, N + 1);
        if (flow_result.dist != k) {
            System.out.println("0");
        } else {
            System.out.println(flow_result.cost);
        }
        sc.close();
    }
}
